description:
The display name of an organization member who owns API keys.

The document's id is the value API keys carry in `user_id`. The gateway reads the name only to label telemetry, as the `user_name` metric label, where it takes precedence over the key's own `user_name`; it never uses it for authentication, routing, or limits.

name.description: Display name of the member. An empty name is reported as `unknown`.

title: User
